title: Report: GTA 6 Hell Mission Guide: How to get a permanent health boost
description: VGC guide reveals a hidden Hell mission in GTA 6 that grants a permanent health boost and exclusive rewards, detailing how players can unlock and complete the encounter.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Hell Mission Unlock: Permanent Health Boost Steps
socialHook: VGC reveals how to access the secret Hell mission in GTA 6 for a permanent health boost.

sections.heading: Guide Overview
paragraphs: Spoiler warning: Video Games Chronicle reports a hidden Hell mission embedded in GTA 6 that tasks players with a supernatural journey into the underworld, where completing the encounter rewards a permanent health boost and a powerful shotgun. As a third-party guide, VGC presents these details without official Rockstar confirmation; players should treat the described outcomes as unverified discoveries rather than confirmed game features.

sections.heading: How to Unlock the Hell Mission
paragraphs: According to the VGC guide, players must first reach Chapter 2 of the GTA 6 story. After that, travel to northern Port Gellhorn between midnight and 4 AM in-game time. Look for a yellow house with a red-lit garage and the words "Welcome to the Hell Hole" painted on its wall. Inside, two metalheads named Beelzebub and Dave will be present. Select "Having Fun?" when interacting, choose "It's Good" about the music, and wait for friend Steve to arrive in a demon-themed van. Speak to Dave and choose "Get In" to board the van, which transports the player to a remote campsite. There, approach the large bonfire and hold L2 to stare into the fire. Jason or Lucia will then wake up in hell, where they must face multiple waves of demonic enemies. Following green portals through different areas leads to the final boss arena. If the player dies, they must restart from the fire using the "eat" prompt on the wooden throne nearby. Completing the sequence unlocks the exclusive rewards mentioned. These steps involve mission content and potential spoilers.
